title: From Reaction to Regeneration: Discovering the Three Earths of Leadership
author: Kathleen Schafer
summary: Schafer offers a three-phase framework of leadership evolution. Earth One is fast-moving response leadership, suited to crisis and control; Earth Two is the conscious choice to reflect, ask and collaborate; and Earth Three is regenerative leadership that creates from presence, love and imagination. She stresses that the phases are a flow rather than a hierarchy and that each leader moves among them in different parts of life. The practical invitation is awareness: notice whether you are reacting or creating, controlling or connecting. The piece is written in an inspirational, values-driven register with reflection questions, so its value lies in the framing of leadership as developmental rather than in empirical support.
points: Leadership is presented as evolutionary, moving from survival response through collaborative reflection to regenerative creation.
Earth One crisis leadership is validated as necessary but insufficient if a leader never moves beyond it.
Earth Two is described as asking rather than telling and aligning rather than controlling, the bridge to co-creating shared systems.
The phases are fluid, so the key skill is noticing which one you are operating from at any given moment.
The closing reflection questions turn the framework into a self-audit of reacting versus creating.
quotes: Earth One energy arises in times of crisis or uncertainty. It is the leadership of first responders, executives under pressure, and systems built for control and efficiency.
Earth One leadership is about doing, holding, and teaching. It meets essential needs with action and care. We could not survive without it, but we cannot thrive if we stay within it.
As crisis subsides, a new possibility emerges. Earth Two leadership invites reflection and collaboration. It is the phase of asking rather than telling, of aligning rather than controlling.
Earth Three is where leadership transcends fixing and begins to create anew. Here, being and doing merge into coherence.
The key is awareness—knowing where we are operating and consciously choosing to move toward balance and love.
The Three Earths are not a hierarchy but a flow. They remind us that leadership is not static.
